digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate P6/AC DET floor (p6_ac_quality lint)
propositions: AC items describing evidence that lives outside the codebase were not tagged [operator-attested], causing the completion verifier to fail looking for code proof until the tag was added retroactively.
Adds an advisory, prompt-less deterministic lexicon lint that flags untagged AC items carrying operational-evidence markers, extending p6_ac_quality without ever blocking.
The lint extends p6_ac_quality and does not add a P10, keeping DET_CHECKS at exactly 9 and CANONICAL_DET unchanged, and adds no criteria_routing.json entry.
The [operator-attested] tag matcher is single-sourced so the plan-time lint and completion-verifier enrichment share one regex object and agree on 'tagged' by construction.
A deterministic self-gate over a frozen historical AC corpus measured flag rate 2.07%, recall 61%, precision ~92%, with both known cases (115b, 8c4f) firing and no LLM call.
The eval was pre-registered as a git ancestor of the activation commit, landed as a two-commit Gerrit stack merged to main with two-vote gate green.
